item.title: PVUSD to slash elementary assistant principals
item.description: When the 2026-27 school year begins in the Pajaro Valley Unified School District, all 17 elementary schools will be without assistant principals. The positions, also referred to as academic coordinators, play an essential role at elementary schools, often handling behavioral issues and other student-centered concerns, allowing principals to focus on administrative duties.
